verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://posthog.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so a downloadable machine-readable spec exists. First-party docs separately describe per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.0 specs (with request/response schemas and auth requirements) fetchable via `/api/projects/{project_id}/endpoints/{endpoint_name}/openapi.json` for generating typed SDK clients. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the site-wide openapi.json and confirming it covers the full PostHog REST API (the documented specs cover only user-defined Endpoints), and independent hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness or usability.
